text:
This video was made by AI.
And everyone's asking the same thing... what's the prompt?
WRONG question.
Because Claude didn't make this alone.
Ask it for a "cool motion video"... and you get slop.
The difference? A director.
His name's Iksan. Iksan Dwee Saputra.
And he turned his motion taste into a formula Claude can read.
Same AI. Different director.
And this video you're watching right now? Made with that exact formula.
Which means Claude can make motion at this level... for ANY theme.
He fed it two hundred and fifty megabytes of official motion docs. Sixty-six expert notes.
And this video? It's already the tutorial.
So... let's cook.
But first, one thing you need to know. Because without it, none of this works for you.
There is no magic prompt. There NEVER was.
What Iksan built is better: a motion brain.
And honestly, it's not just a prompt. It's a full library.
Because the docs... ARE the skill.
Twelve categories that teach Claude to think like a real motion designer... and editor.
Choreography. Physics. Shaders. Typography. Sound. Rendering.
Not a prompt. A whole studio, in one folder.
Here's the part nobody tells you.
To build this, Iksan directed every detail himself.
Every library. Every rule. Every fix.
Make it smoother. Lower that whoosh. Hold the ending one beat longer.
Now all of that lives inside the formula.
The formula is the framework. It does the heavy lifting.
The rest? That's YOU.
Your idea. Your taste. Your theme.
Football. Fashion. Science. Food. Anything.
He did the hard part, so you don't have to.
Comment MOTION, and follow for part two.
